en.headline: Police arrest 16 including 13-year-old in New Territories South youth crime crackdown
en.dek: Eleven of those held were aged 13 to 21; officers seized suspected etomidate vape cartridges and nicotine products during the two-day operation targeting juvenile offences.
body: Police in New Territories South have arrested 16 people, including a 13-year-old boy, in a two-day operation aimed at tackling youth crime during the summer holidays.

The arrestees, aged 13 to 39, included 11 teenagers. They were detained on suspicion of offences including disorderly conduct in a public place, possession of offensive weapons, possession of dangerous drugs, obtaining property by deception and common assault. Chief Inspector Wong Chi-tang said the force remained concerned about youth crime and urged young people not to break the law out of momentary mischief or peer pressure.

In Kwai Tsing, officers arrested nine people aged 14 to 28 and seized four suspected etomidate e-cigarette cartridges, one e-cigarette device and 91 nicotine cartridges with a total estimated value of about HK$5,100. Two secondary-school students were also arrested in connection with earlier reports of youths causing nuisance at Kwai Chung Plaza. In Tsuen Wan, a 13-year-old boy was among those held over a June shop-theft case involving goods worth about HK$4,000.

New Territories South recorded 410 criminal cases involving people aged 10 to 20 in the first half of 2026, up about 34 per cent from the same period last year. Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office officers also issued fixed-penalty notices during the patrols of youth gathering spots.

zh.headline: 新界南打擊青少年罪行拘16人 最細13歲
zh.dek: 11名被捕者年齡介乎13至21歲；行動中檢獲懷疑依托咪酯電子煙彈及尼古丁煙彈，針對暑假期間青少年罪行。
body: 新界南總區一連兩日展開代號「犁庭掃穴」行動，打擊暑假期間青少年罪行，合共拘捕16人，當中包括一名13歲男童。
被捕者年齡介乎13至39歲，其中11人為13至21歲青少年，涉嫌在公眾地方行為不檢、管有攻擊性武器、管有危險藥物、以欺騙手段取得財產及普通襲擊等罪名。總區總督察黃志騰表示，警方持續關注青少年罪案，呼籲年輕人勿因一時貪玩或同輩壓力而觸犯法例。
葵青警區共拘捕9人（14至28歲），並檢獲4粒懷疑依托咪酯電子煙彈、一支電子煙槍及91粒含尼古丁電子煙彈，市值約5,100元。因應早前葵涌廣場商戶遭童黨滋擾的報道，警方再拘捕兩名中學生。荃灣警區則拘捕包括一名13歲男童在內的人士，涉6月下旬一宗店舖盜竊案，失物約值4,000元。
新界南總區今年上半年錄得410宗涉及10至20歲青少年的刑事案件，較去年同期上升約34%。行動期間控煙酒辦公室人員亦向違規人士發出定額罰款通知書。
